records.status: Captured in the sanitized inventory; source text hashes verified
records.findings: Board 8716 / BIOS T90 01.25.00; CPU family 6 model 140 (0x8C) stepping 1; GPU 8086:9A49 rev 01, subsystem 103C:8716; the 2026-10-15 Linux i915 capture reports B0, 80 EU and 5 subslices; a separate later runtime observation reports 80 EU / 10 subslices (see the public current-status index); BIOS reports Video Memory Size 512 MB and GGC 0x10c1. Detailed DVMT register decoding remains incomplete.

records.status: VBT and EDID acquired with verified SHA-256; i915 route/timing captured
records.findings: IVO8596 X133NVFF R0, 1920x1080; eDP-1 pipe A / DDI A / PHY A, two lanes at 2700 Mbps per lane; pixel clock 138.8 MHz and port clock 270 MHz (i915 units confirmed). DPCD is only an i915 summary reporting revision 1.2; full AUX/DPCD dump is absent.
